papers.title: Stale but Stable: Staleness-Adaptive Trust Regions for Stabilizing Asynchronous Reinforcement Learning
papers.what: A staleness-adaptive clipping rule for asynchronous RL that tightens only the outward PPO interval on high-mismatch tokens, holding AIME24 avg@8 near 35 even at lag 8 on Qwen3-30B.

papers.title: ISO: An RLVR-Native Optimization Stack
papers.what: Shows RLVR mostly keeps a model's singular-value spectrum and moves new behavior into the singular frames, then freezes the spectrum and optimizes only the frames to reach matched accuracy in up to 2.7x fewer steps.

papers.title: AlayaWorld: Interactive Long-Horizon World Modeling
papers.authors: AlayaWorld Team, Zhang et al. (Alaya Lab)
papers.what: A 15B video diffusion transformer that generates interactive 24-fps worlds autoregressively, using a bounded memory and self-residual training to limit drift and four-step distillation for interactive speed.

papers.title: AgentDebugX: Failure Observability, Attribution, and Recovery in LLM Agents
papers.what: A Detect-Attribute-Recover-Rerun debugging loop for LLM agents; its DeepDebug root-cause diagnosis reaches 28.8% exact step attribution and repairs 13 of 73 failed GAIA tasks in one rerun.
papers.builds_on: Agent AI Survey (Durante 2024); Memory Mechanisms Survey (Huang 2026); ToolkenGPT (Hao 2024)
